activities.procedure_required: Commissioning procedure for bearing movement and joint operation
activities.acceptance_criteria: Bearings and joints verified to design movement; joint watertightness confirmed.

activities.procedure_required: Outfall proving and CCTV survey procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Confined-space / watercourse risk assessed before proving
activities.acceptance_criteria: All outfalls proven free-flowing and connecting as designed; CCTV accepted.
Compaction validated to specification; density and thickness confirmed.

activities.procedure_required: Energisation procedure with permit-to-work and lock-off
activities.acceptance_criteria: Lighting energised into operation; photometric and circuit tests passed.

activities.procedure_required: End-to-end integration test procedure (MIDAS, ERF, HSR, HAR)
activities.safety_hold_point: Confirm fail-safe and fallback before any operational use
activities.acceptance_criteria: Integration test passed; detector accuracy and control-room response verified.

activities.procedure_required: VRS acceptance and certification confirmation procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: No opening of carriageway until VRS acceptance confirmed
activities.acceptance_criteria: Installed VRS matches a certified system; containment and working width confirmed.

activities.activity: Traffic trial load & structural loading check
activities.safety_hold_point: Exclusion zone during loading; monitoring in place
activities.acceptance_criteria: Load test accepted; deflections within limits; no distress.

activities.activity: Final snagging walkdown with National Highways
activities.procedure_required: Joint walkdown and snagging close-out procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Traffic management in place for walkdown
activities.acceptance_criteria: Walkdown signed off by National Highways; residual snagging list agreed.

prerequisites: Road open or about to open
activities.procedure_required: Stage 3 Road Safety Audit procedure (DMRB CD 377)
activities.safety_hold_point: Audit recommendations addressed before full opening
activities.acceptance_criteria: Stage 3 RSA report issued and recommendations closed out.

activities.safety_hold_point: Maintainer acceptance before transfer of responsibility
activities.acceptance_criteria: As-built record and O&M manuals accepted by the maintainer; completion certificate issued.

activities.safety_hold_point: Confirm redundant comms paths before go-live
activities.acceptance_criteria: Communications verified; redundancy and failover tested.

activities.activity: Pavement ride quality & skid resistance validation
activities.procedure_required: Ride quality and skid resistance measurement procedure
activities.acceptance_criteria: Ride quality and SCRIM/skid values within specification.
Shut-off/pollution devices operate as designed; alarms tested.

activities.procedure_required: CCTV and incident detection commissioning procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Image and alert verification before operational use
activities.acceptance_criteria: Coverage, image quality and incident-detection alerts verified.

activities.procedure_required: Completion certificate issue and handover procedure
activities.acceptance_criteria: Completion certificate issued; scheme accepted by National Highways and the maintainer.
